items.summary: whatsmeow initialization duplicated between runServer and runWorker — same setup appears twice with subtle differences

evidence: runServer (lines 260-303) initializes whatsmeowManager, sets InboundMediaQueue, CampaignStatsPublisher, MediaService, starts HealthMonitor, reconciles statuses, auto-connects instances

runWorker (lines 680-714) re-initializes whatsmeowManager from scratch: creates store container, upgrades it, creates ConnectionManager, sets InboundMediaQueue, CampaignStatsPublisher, MediaService, starts HealthMonitor, reconciles statuses, auto-connects
runWorker version passes nil for wsHub (line 691: "whatsmeow.NewConnectionManager(db, storeContainer, lo, &cfg.Whatsmeow, nil, cfg.Storage.LocalPath)") while runServer passes wsHub
Any change to whatsmeow initialization ordering must be made in both places
runWorker initializes whatsmeowAdapter directly (line 713) while runServer also initializes it separately (line 343)
detail.suggestion: Extract a shared newWhatsmeowComponents(cfg, db, log) function or NewServerComponents factory that returns all initialized whatsmeow parts, used by both runServer and runWorker. The two callers can selectively opt in/out of WebSocket hub binding.
